{
  "verdict": "fix",
  "issues": [
    "GET /tasks returns an unbounded array with no pagination, filtering, sorting, or maximum limit, which can cause performance, memory, and availability problems as task count grows.",
    "PATCH semantics are underspecified: behavior for empty bodies, unknown fields, invalid field types, blank or excessively long titles, and no-op updates is not defined.",
    "Server-generated fields (id, createdAt, updatedAt) are not explicitly declared read-only; the API does not state whether they are ignored or rejected if supplied in POST or PATCH payloads.",
    "The update flow lacks concurrency control, so concurrent PATCH requests can silently overwrite each other unless last-write-wins is explicitly accepted.",
    "Validation constraints are incomplete: title has no maximum length or character policy, and completed has no explicit rules beyond being boolean.",
    "The specification does not define when updatedAt changes, especially for PATCH requests that contain valid but unchanged values.",
    "Error handling is incomplete for cases such as malformed JSON, unsupported Content-Type, unsupported methods, and validation failures other than TASK_NOT_FOUND.",
    "The lack of authentication and authorization creates a serious exposure risk if the API is deployed beyond a controlled demo, and the proposal does not state deployment restrictions or mitigations."
  ],
  "suggestions": [
    "Add pagination to GET /tasks, for example limit and cursor or offset parameters, with a default limit and a maximum limit.",
    "Define PATCH validation explicitly: require at least one mutable field, reject invalid types, reject or ignore unknown fields, and return 400 with a VALIDATION_ERROR code.",
    "Declare id, createdAt, and updatedAt as read-only server-generated fields and specify whether client-provided values are ignored or cause a 400 error.",
    "Specify title constraints, such as minimum length 1, maximum length, and trimming behavior for surrounding whitespace.",
    "State precisely how updatedAt is maintained, for example updating it only when a PATCH successfully changes task state.",
    "Add a concurrency mechanism such as ETag plus If-Match, or explicitly document that PATCH uses last-write-wins.",
    "Expand the error model with codes such as INVALID_JSON, INVALID_CONTENT_TYPE, VALIDATION_ERROR, and METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED while keeping the existing error object shape.",
    "If the API may be exposed beyond a local or demo environment, require authentication and authorization, or at minimum document that it must only run in a trusted, non-public environment."
  ]
}
